description:
About Bask Health
 Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
 Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.
 We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.
 Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.
 About the Role
 We're looking for a Full Stack Product Engineer to help build and improve the merchant-facing tools that power businesses on Bask Health.
 You'll work across the frontend and backend to create intuitive, reliable experiences that help merchants launch, configure, and manage their telehealth businesses.
 This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys building real product features, solving technical challenges, and seeing their work directly improve the customer experience.
 You'll collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver features from development through production. We're looking for someone who takes ownership, cares about usability, and enjoys working across the entire application stack.
 What You'll Do
 Build and maintain full-stack features for Bask's merchant platform.
 Develop merchant-facing interfaces using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
 Build backend functionality and services using Node.js and TypeScript.
 Improve merchant onboarding and business configuration workflows.
 Develop tools for managing merchant storefronts and settings.
 Build and refine product catalog and product configuration experiences.
 Contribute to subscription management and commerce-related functionality.
 Create intuitive dashboards and interfaces for merchant operations.
 Develop and integrate APIs connecting frontend applications with backend services.
 Work with SQL databases to store, retrieve, and manage application data.
 Collaborate with product managers and designers to translate requirements into working features.
 Implement responsive, accessible, and reusable frontend components.
 Help improve the usability and performance of merchant-facing applications.
 Integrate frontend experiences with existing backend systems.
 Support workflows connecting merchant tools with other Bask platform capabilities.
 Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
 Participate in code reviews and collaborate on technical improvements.
 Investigate and resolve bugs across frontend and backend applications.
 Contribute to application testing and quality assurance.
 Help maintain secure and reliable handling of merchant data.
 Identify opportunities to simplify merchant workflows and reduce unnecessary steps.
 Participate in feature planning, technical discussions, and implementation decisions.
 Use AI-assisted development tools while reviewing and validating generated code.
 Take ownership of assigned features through implementation, deployment, and follow-up improvements.
 Requirements 
 
 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, preferably in full-stack or product engineering.
 Experience building and maintaining production web applications.
 Strong working knowledge of JavaScript and TypeScript.
 Hands-on experience developing frontend applications with React.
 Experience with Next.js or comparable React-based frameworks.
 Experience developing backend services using Node.js or a comparable server-side framework.
 Understanding of REST APIs and frontend-to-backend integration.
 Experience working with SQL databases and relational data.
 Ability to implement features across both frontend and backend systems.
 Familiarity with frontend state management and reusable component patterns.
 Understanding of responsive design and web accessibility principles.
 Experience debugging frontend and backend application issues.
 Familiarity with authentication, authorization, and application security.
 Experience working with Git and collaborative development workflows.
 Understanding of software testing and maintainable code practices.
 Ability to work with existing codebases and contribute improvements.
 Experience collaborating with engineers, product managers, or designers.
 Ability to translate product requirements into functional application features.
 Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
 Ability to communicate technical decisions and implementation progress clearly.
 Comfort taking ownership of assigned engineering work.
 Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote environment.
 Nice to Have
 Experience developing merchant-facing SaaS applications.
 Familiarity with e-commerce platforms or direct-to-consumer businesses.
 Experience with Shopify integrations or merchant tools.
 Experience building product catalogs, merchant dashboards, or storefront management interfaces.
 Familiarity with subscription commerce and recurring billing workflows.
 Experience integrating payment systems such as Stripe.
 Experience with AWS or serverless application development.
 Familiarity with SST, AWS Lambda, SQS, or EventBridge.
 Experience with tRPC, Prisma, or Drizzle ORM.
 Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architectures.
 Experience working in a TypeScript monorepo.
 Experience building reusable design system components.
 Familiarity with frontend performance optimization.
 Experience developing analytics or reporting interfaces.
 Understanding of merchant onboarding and conversion optimization.
 Experience with healthcare, telehealth, or regulated software.
 Familiarity with privacy and security requirements for sensitive data.
 Experience using AI development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.
